title: Matam Karo
body:
ay azadaron ay wafadaron
ay azadaron sheh ke ghamkhwaron
<<DIVIDER>>
aagaya maahe aza ahle aza matam karo
hai janaab e sayyeda ki ye sada matam karo
<<DIVIDER>>
chand jab maahe moharram ka nazar aane lage
kaifiyat aisi ho chehra gham se murjhane lage
karke rukh apna suye karbobala matam karo
aagaya maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab kahin farshe aza bichne lage rakhna khayal
teen din ki pyas mein maara gaya hai mera laal
hai yehi mere dukhe dil ki dawa matam karo
aagaya maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
bekhata maara gaya mera pisar pardes mein
loot daala zalimon ne mera ghar pardes mein
hogayi mere dulaaron par jafa matam karo
aagaya maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
eid ke din mere baba jiska naaqa khud bane
leke kapde khuld se aaya malak jiske liye
uska laasha teen din uryan raha matam karo
aagaya maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere bacche ka tha ek beta jo tha kadiyal jawan
ek baccha cheh mahine ka tha asghar bezaban
ho gaye pardes mein dono juda matam karo
aagaya maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
seena e akbar pe jab naiza laga mai paas thi
jab mera abbas ghode se gira mai paas thi
bat gaya tukdon mein dil us dam mera matam karo
aagaya maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere dil ka dard tumko dekh kar hota hai kam
ay azadaron manao mere shehzadon ka gham
doongi mai mehshar ke din iska sila matam karo
aagaya maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab talak saansein hai waiz ye aza jaari rahe
tum raho ya na raho lekin azadari rahe
ay ali chalta rahe ye silsila matam karo
aagaya maahe aza...
author: Waiz Sultanpuri
